newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Marlin to be world's biggest granite firm.
newsitem.headline: Marlin to be world's biggest granite firm.

text.p: A planned tie-up announced on Monday between South African granite firms Marlin Corp and Kudu Granite Ltd is set to create the world's biggest granite producer.
The deal, terms of which are still sketchy, will see Marlin take a 58.8 percent stake in Kudu -- the latest in a series of buys by the acquisitive firm.
"If this goes ahead, and we are confident it will, it will make Marlin the biggest granite firm in the world," Marlin finance director Ian Macmillan told Reuters.

The firms announced the deal in a brief statement, but gave no financial details as the finer points have yet to be ironed out with Kudu's majority shareholder Deutsche Steinindustrie and Anglo American Corp, which holds a stake in Steindindustrie.
But Macmillan said he could see foresee few problems.
"There is a signed agreement, but there are also conditions precedent to be fulfilled," he said.

Kudu has been on the market for some time and was in talks with Marlin's fellow South African and main rival Kelgran Ltd. But Kelgran's main shareholder, Malaysian group Mycom SA, said on Friday that it had terminated the talks.
Macmillan said Marlin's "more attractive" deal had swayed discussions in favour of Marlin.
